TEST 3 - Dietary Preference Selection: After meal type, shows Vegetarian, Vegan, Non-Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Any (5/5)

TEST 4 - Cuisine Selection: After dietary pref, shows 11 cuisine options (Mexican, Italian, Chinese, Indian, Japanese, Thai, Mediterranean, American, Korean, Middle Eastern, Surprise Me) with multi-select capability
TEST 5 - Recipe Generation: After cuisine selection, AI generates meal-appropriate recipes (e.g., Risotto Primavera, Eggplant Caponata for Italian Vegetarian Lunch)
TEST 6 - Selection Badges: All selections shown as badges at top (mood: Happy, meal type: Lunch, dietary: Vegetarian, cuisine: Italian)
TEST 7 - Chat Persistence: Navigate to List/Planner and return - chat history preserved via localStorage
TEST 8 - New Chat Button: Clicking 'New Chat' resets the conversation and shows fresh mood selector
TEST 9 - Navigation: Home, Chat, List, Planner tabs all work correctly (4/4 navigation tabs functional)
